title: Six-class checkpoint rho with the unit inside the coefficient product

claims.statement: For uniform x in [0, r) and input T=[x]P0 on the fixed BLS12-381 G1 generator, the six-class checkpoint rho of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 2/5 under the random-mapping heuristic stated there, which is at least 0.39, using at most 2^126.714832 target-group-operation equivalents. The bound includes preprocessing, the distinguished-point overhead, exceptional additions, lookup traffic and one verification multiplication. Peak memory is at most 2^39.152152 bytes. Preprocessing is at most 2^28.989831 target-group-operation equivalents and is included in the total. Nonuniform advice is at most 2^0 bytes and is included in memory. The walk multiplies both GLV coefficient pairs by the same unit that canonicalises the point, and it multiplies the post-jump sum. Infinity returns scalar 0.

experiments.purpose: Self-contained single-file check (the runner executes only this entrypoint, so it inlines reference.py): verify the six unit matrices match multiplication by ±λ^k, φ(P0)=[λ]P0 with one β-multiplication, four real-curve steps preserve [α]T+[β]P0, the integral budget inequality holds, and the same post-jump update recovers every secret on a prime cyclic group of order less than 2^bits. This is not a production cost measurement.
